settings.question: Where do we ship to?
settings.answer:
For products from Indian Rug Store, our shipping destinations include the U.S. (including Alaska and Hawaii), Canada, the UK, Germany, France, Australia, and Austria.

We do not deliver to P.O. Boxes (including APO and FPO) or the U.S. Territories. Should your order contain a P.O. Box address, a member of our Customer Care team will contact you for an alternative address. Failure to receive a response within seven days from the original order date will result in the cancellation of your order.

If you reside in a different country, kindly email our Customer Care team at support@indianrugstore.com, providing your name, country, and email address to be added to our mailing list. We will notify you once we commence shipping to your country.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer:
Our products are custom-made, so production begins once your order is placed! We anticipate shipping your order within 15 to 20 days.

You can monitor any updates to your order here.

Please be aware that if your order surpasses our current 1 to 3-week timeframe, we kindly request that you wait at least 48 hours for the tracker to update before contacting our Customer Care team.

Note: For certain products, we also provide an Express Shipping option.

settings.question: How much does express shipping cost?
settings.answer: If your order qualifies for express shipping, you will see the cost listed at checkout. It varies based on your order.

settings.question: Where does free  apply to?
settings.answer:
Free shipping is valid for standard shipping within the contiguous U.S. and Canada, excluding Hawaii, Alaska, and U.S. Territories.

We do not deliver to P.O. Boxes (including APO and FPO) or the U.S. Territories.
